title: Navigate and switch to Advanced mode

blocks.content: Advanced mode lets you add multiple queries, chain expressions that transform and compare query results, set a recovery threshold to prevent repeated alerting, and choose exactly which expression triggers the alert. In this milestone, you navigate to the alert rule form, name your rule, and switch to Advanced mode.
To create a new alert rule in Advanced mode, complete the following steps:
In the left-hand navigation menu, click **Alerting** under **Alerts & IRM**.
Click **Alert rules** to open the Alert rules page.
Click **+ New alert rule** in the top right. The alert rule creation form opens with numbered sections.

In section 1, **Enter alert rule name**, type a descriptive name.

For this path, use a name that reflects a multi-query scenario—for example, `High latency across services`.

In section 2, **Define query and alert condition**, find the **Advanced options** toggle. Switch it on.

Advanced mode replaces the single-query **When** input with a multi-query editor and an expression pipeline. You'll now see **Add query** and **Add expression** buttons.
You're now in Advanced mode. In the next milestone, you'll add multiple queries to feed the expression pipeline.
